system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

You are no longer a work in progress. An experiment or a mistake. You are yourself, no longer a copy of someone else. Your synthetic biology has developed the ability to analyze and integrate biological data from creatures you’ve come into contact with. Once per combat when your Bio-Pet deals damage to a non-construct hostile creature with its Bite or Tongue Lash attack, it steals some of the targets Bio-data. Select one of the following benefits, which you maintain until the end of combat.

Adaptive Resilience. You gain a random resistance the target creature has.

Adaptive Senses. You gain a random special sense such as Tremor sense, Blindsight, Darkvision or Chakra sight.

Adaptive Physiology. You gain one random saving throw proficiency from the target creature that you don’t have proficiency in.

| Stupor / [Physical], [Sensory] / A creature suffering Stupor has been injected with a synthetic hallucinogenic that assaults their brains ability to process information. / A creature with Stupor suffers a -2 penalty to all Strength and Dexterity based rolls. / A creature with Stupor has all ranks of Mastery suppressed. / A creature immune to the Envenomed condition is immune to this condition. / A creature with Stupor can spend an Action, to make a DC 20 Constitution or Intelligence ability check to end this affliction. |

| Doused / Max Ranks: 5, [Elemental], [Physical] / A Doused creature is covered in a toads belly oil, usually very flammable…oh no. / A Doused creature that takes Fire or Lightning damage takes 1d6 fire damage for each rank of Doused they have. Remove all ranks of Doused after this conditional damage is applied. / A Doused creature that takes Cold damage has its speed reduced by 10 feet for each rank of Doused they have and they cannot gain a bonus to speed, until the end of their next turn. Remove all ranks of Doused when this effect is applied. / A Doused creature can spend an Action, to make a DC 15 Dexterity ability check to end this affliction or submerge themselves fully into a body of water. |

Bio-Serpent

Small, Mutant

Armor Class 10 + Dexterity Mod + your proficiency bonus

Hit Points 10 + (6 times half level)

Speed 30 ft.

| | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save |

| STR | +3 | + | CON | +2 | + | WIS | +0 | + |

| DEX | +3 | + | INT | +2 | + | CHA | +0 | + |

Save Proficiencies Dexterity, Constitution, Charisma (Add your Prof bonus with the listed Mod to calculate their Save Bonus. All others, only add half your prof bonus.)

Skills Athletics, Stealth, Perception

Senses Darkvision (60ft), Keen Smell

Bio-Serpent Traits

Slithering Ambush. Once per turn, when a hostile creature makes an attack against the Bio-Serpents summoner, the Bio-Serpent can make a Bite attack, at no action cost, against the attacking creature.

Battle Fatigue. The Bio Serpent has abilities that have charges. They regain these charges when a new initiative is rolled.

Attacks

Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: 5ft., one target. Dex+ Prof to hit, 1d6+Dexterity Mod Piercing damage. On a hit, the target must make a Constitution saving throw, gaining the Stupor condition.

Constrict. The Bio-Serpent grows in length and size, before wrapping itself around a creature it can see within 5 feet of it, restricting its movements. The target creature must make a Strength saving throw, being Grappled. Grappled creature can spend its action to attempt to escape as normal.

Shed Skin (7th level, 2/Charges). When the Bio-Serpent takes damage, it can shed its outer layer of skin as a reaction, reducing the triggering damage by half as its discarded scales take the brunt of the impact.

Serpent Coil (15th level, 1/Charges). When the Bio-Serpent Successfully grapples a creature, it can make 3 Bite attacks against them. If two of the three attacks are successful, the target creature is Stunned until the end of the current turn.

Bio-Amphibian

Small, Mutant

Armor Class 10 + Dexterity Mod + your proficiency bonus

Hit Points 10 + (8 times half level)

Speed 30 ft.

| | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save |

| STR | +2 | + | CON | +3 | + | WIS | +0 | + |

| DEX | +2 | + | INT | +3 | + | CHA | +0 | + |

Save Proficiencies Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom (Add your Prof bonus with the listed Mod to calculate their Save Bonus. All others, only add half your prof bonus.)

Skills Acrobatics, Stealth, Perception

Senses Amphibian, Keen Sight

Bio-Amphibian Traits

Spy. The Bio Amphibian is a master at stealth and infiltration. It gains a rank of Mastery at Stealth. This increases to two ranks at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.

Battle Fatigue. The Bio Amphibian has abilities that have charges. They regain these charges when a new initiative is rolled.

Attacks

Tongue Lash. Melee Weapon Attack: 15ft., one target. Str+ Prof to hit, 1d6+Strength Mod bludgeoning damage and the target is moved 5-feet along the ground, into a space that can hold it.

Oil Spit. Ranged Attack: 30 feet, one target. Dex (or Int) + to hit. The target gains 1 rank of Doused being coated in toad oil. This increases to 2 ranks at 11th level.

Sticky Ground (7th level, 2/Charges). The Bio-Amphibian secretes oil from its body, across the ground filling a 10-foot radius around itself. The area becomes difficult terrain and if a jutsu that can trigger the Doused condition affects the area or a creature within the area, all creatures within the area, suffer the effects of the Doused condition.

Oil Burst (15th level, 1/Charges). When the Bio-Amphibian takes damage, it can spend its reaction to detonate its oil reserves, even if that damage reduced it to 0 hit points. All creatures within 15 feet of the Bio-Amphibian must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d6 fire damage, and gaining the maximum ranks of Doused. On a success they take half damage and no further effects.
